title: spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md:389 - SF8 missing from thresholds table
description: The Adaptive SF thresholds table lists SF 7, 9, 10, 11, 12 but omits SF8. However, AdaptiveSFSelect step 4 can produce SF8 via 'SF = MAX(7, SF - 1)' when upgrading from SF9. Implementations have no defined sensitivity or transition conditions for SF8, making the procedure behavior undefined for this case.
